This tracks rewards only — it does not connect to Roblox or transfer Robux automatically. Each stage reward can only be earned once per word.

Daily streak rewards

A day only counts once the child has answered the required number of different spelling words correctly. Opening the app alone does not continue the streak.

Parent security

Progress controls

Progress is saved automatically on this device using browser localStorage. Use Export progress backup before clearing browser/site data or moving to another device.
